title: Titanium Sintered Filter Element
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this filtration application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by sintered titanium porous filter element and specific design requirements.
process: CNC machining from plate for filtration geometry
TIG welding all-position for net-shape tolerance
Passivation DI rinse for net-shape tolerance
surfaceTreatment: Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces
commonFailures: Crevice corrosion under gasket in wet service - mitigated by raised-face flange design per ASME B16.5

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Sintered Filter Element suitable for Sintered titanium porous filter element?
faq.a: Titanium Sintered Filter Element uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address filtration operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Sintered Filter Element?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Sintered Filter Element require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. filtration components receive Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Sintered Filter Element shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Sintered filter / Porous tube filtration components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
